parser_help.cy-init-config:
usage: cy-init-config [-h]
                      [--command {cy,cy-train,cy-predict,cy-val,cy-metrics,cy-report,cy-compare,cy-ground-truth,cy-export}]
                      [--force] [--model MODEL]
                      directory

CLI: initialize a directory with editable example configurations.

positional arguments:
  directory             directory for example YAML configurations

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --command {cy,cy-train,cy-predict,cy-val,cy-metrics,cy-report,cy-compare,cy-ground-truth,cy-export}
                        execution command to configure (default: cy)
  --force               overwrite existing example files
  --model MODEL         model preset (default: ultralytics; Faster R-CNN for
                        cy-export)
parser_help.cy-dedup:
usage: cy-dedup [-h] [--dry-run] [directory]

Reflink identical, same-named cache images without starting application
services.

positional arguments:
  directory   cache to scan (default: CY_HOME/.cache or .cache in the current
              directory)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --dry-run   report duplicate candidates without creating or replacing files
parser_help.cy-batch-estimate:
usage: cy-batch-estimate [-h] --imgsz IMGSZ [--classes CLASSES]
                         [--objects-per-image OBJECTS_PER_IMAGE]
                         [--models MODELS] [--devices DEVICES]
                         [--gpu-counts GPU_COUNTS] [--refresh]
                         [--memory-budget MEMORY_BUDGET]
                         [--search-limit SEARCH_LIMIT]
                         [--trial-timeout TRIAL_TIMEOUT]

Measure single-GPU training capacity and extrapolate selected allocations.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --imgsz IMGSZ         nominal square training resolution
  --classes CLASSES     synthetic classes (default: 150)
  --objects-per-image OBJECTS_PER_IMAGE
                        synthetic objects (default: 300)
  --models MODELS       comma-separated model presets or YOLO asset names;
                        default: all
  --devices DEVICES     ordered logical visible CUDA indexes; default: all
  --gpu-counts GPU_COUNTS
                        report recommendations for first N selected GPUs; no
                        extra searches; default: 1..all
  --refresh             repeat completed compatible cases
  --memory-budget MEMORY_BUDGET
                        fraction of each GPU's total memory (default: 0.9)
  --search-limit SEARCH_LIMIT
                        per-GPU search ceiling (default: 1024); extrapolated
                        global batches may exceed it
  --trial-timeout TRIAL_TIMEOUT
                        seconds per fresh trial group (default: 300)
